user_query: I'm organizing a workshop and need to validate the email addresses of the participants. Please verify their email addresses and provide their general account information. Additionally, check the SMTP details for their email addresses.

TaskList.description: Collect a list of participant email addresses from the workshop registration.
Validate the email addresses to ensure they are correctly formatted and active.
Retrieve general account information associated with the validated email addresses.
Check SMTP details for the validated email addresses to ensure they can receive messages.
